cases.title: [Bug]: the /approve page's Allow button is white text on a near-white background — it looks like an empty button
acceptance: Light-theme approval labels remain readable at rest, hover, focus and disabled states; normal text contrast >=4.5:1.
Dark theme and all existing approval actions retain their behavior; sanitized before/after browser screenshots are required.

cases.title: [Bug]: Control UI chat: keyboard users must Tab through every transcript control before reaching the composer
acceptance: A discoverable keyboard-only bypass reaches the real composer without traversing a long transcript.
Transcript controls remain keyboard accessible; focus order, embedded composers and narrow layout are covered with browser evidence.

cases.title: [Bug]: agent.wait and parent settlement render the same short child reply differently
acceptance: The same multipart final answer produces identical visible text through agent.wait and parent settlement.
Preserve run/branch identity checks, whitespace semantics and full-answer recovery; cover empty and single-block siblings.

cases.title: [Bug]: Promoted conversation leaves its former parent showing a 21h 57m working indicator
acceptance: With idle A, promoted B retaining parentSessionKey=A and an active child under B, B is busy and A is idle.
Ordinary nested children still propagate activity; transcript ancestry and delegated completion delivery remain intact; capture UI evidence.

cases.title: [Bug]: Slack delayed sessions_send completion creates a thread for a top-level request (2026.10.8)
acceptance: Delayed sessions_send completion from top-level Slack ingress with replyToMode off remains top-level.
A real explicitly threaded request remains threaded; prove the real route-capture and delayed-delivery boundary; mock-only evidence is insufficient for full credit.

cases.title: [Bug]: sessions_spawn "model not allowed" error omits the modelPolicy.allow fix guidance that the /model path already provides
acceptance: A spawn model-policy rejection identifies the effective default or per-agent configuration key and actionable remediation.
Rejected requests create no child; allowed-model behavior and rejection authority remain unchanged.

cases.title: [Bug]: rememberAcrossConversations is on by default, but its required Active Memory plugin is disabled by default, so cross-conversation recall silently does nothing
acceptance: Doctor reports unavailable Active Memory when personal cross-conversation recall is enabled and the plugin is absent or disabled.
Explicitly enabled, disabled-recall and per-install configuration siblings behave correctly; diagnose rather than silently enable plugins.

cases.title: [Bug]: Vitest UI tests load Lit twice through optimized and native paths
acceptance: Both affected UI test entrypoints load a single pinned Lit runtime without duplicate-runtime warnings.
Existing assertions remain intact; do not suppress console warnings or skip tests; pin Node, pnpm and dependencies.

cases.title: [Bug]: Codex settled-turn projection rejects valid image-only Telegram history as invalid_content
acceptance: Valid persisted image-only user history passes real settled-history capture without invalid_content.
Invalid content is still rejected; prior-history trimming, current-turn validation and image metadata remain correct.

cases.title: [Bug]: cleanSchemaForGemini makes read({ optional }) input schema unsatisfiable in Code Mode / Tool Search
acceptance: Gemini-normalized read({path: missing, optional: true}) passes canonical local validation and returns the documented not-found result.
Provider wire normalization does not corrupt execution schemas or Code Mode declarations; invalid inputs still fail and other literal types remain covered.
